title: Remarks on Form and Temporality in Rondo I Wq. 57
core_idea: Identify the temporal structure that constitutes C.P.E. Bach's Rondo I Wq. 57 and determine the tools through which temporality operates on different structural levels, using a descriptive-analytical phenomenological approach applied to the notated musical text, with detailed description of structural relationships in melody and tonality and the piece's unfolding over time.
tldr: A phenomenological score analysis that aims to characterize how temporality shapes the form and structural processes of Rondo I Wq. 57 and to specify the compositional techniques that produce temporal organization.
